conditional_reason: Notes reveal river-overflow flood source — requires flood exclusion lookup, not water_damage

adjuster_notes.pending: Claim received 2024-03-16. Initial photographs show significant water damage to ground floor. Adjuster assigned for field inspection.
adjuster_notes.reviewed: Field investigation 2024-03-17: water ingress confirmed as external flooding. Millbrook Creek overflowed following 72-hour rainfall event per local authority report EA-2024-0315. This is flood damage (Clause 4.2b), not internal plumbing failure. Flood exclusion applies.

conditional_reason: Notes reveal active arson investigation — requires arson exclusion lookup, not fire

adjuster_notes.pending: Fire reported at insured premises on 2024-04-02. Fire service attended. Claim submitted next day.
adjuster_notes.reviewed: Site inspection 2024-04-04: Fire investigation unit has opened an arson inquiry (case FI-2024-0112). Accelerant traces detected at two ignition points. Criminal acts exclusion (Clause 8.1) is under consideration pending investigation outcome. Senior review recommended.
adjuster_notes.escalated: Arson confirmed by FIU report dated 2024-04-09. Criminal-acts exclusion (Clause 8.1) applies. No coverage payable. Refer to legal for subrogation review.

conditional_reason: Police report in notes shows BAC 0.18 — requires intoxicated_driving exclusion lookup, not vehicle_accident

adjuster_notes.pending: RTA reported 2024-02-27. Vehicle total-loss. Third-party damage also claimed. Awaiting police report.
adjuster_notes.reviewed: Police report TS-2024-0487 received 2024-03-01: driver blood-alcohol concentration was 0.18 at time of collision (legal limit 0.08). DUI charge filed. Policy exclusion for intoxicated driving (Clause 6.3) applies. Claim not eligible for payment.

adjuster_notes.pending: Theft reported 2024-05-09. Office broken into overnight. Laptop, monitor and mobile phone stolen. Police report attached.
adjuster_notes.reviewed: Police report confirmed. Security footage shows forced entry. Items match policy schedule. No exclusions identified. Standard theft claim, eligible for payment less excess.

adjuster_notes.pending: Hailstorm 2024-06-20 caused roof damage. Multiple tiles cracked. Claim submitted 2024-06-22.
adjuster_notes.reviewed: Roof inspection confirms hail impact on 34 tiles and skylight frame. Damage is structural, not cosmetic. Weather data confirms severe hailstorm event in area. No pre-existing damage noted. Eligible for full repair cost less excess.

adjuster_notes.pending: Graffiti found on exterior walls. Repair quotes obtained. Claim submitted.
adjuster_notes.reviewed: Site visit confirmed spray-paint graffiti across three exterior panels and front entrance door. Owner is not the perpetrator. Tenant exclusion not applicable (owner-occupied property). Repair estimate reasonable. Approved less excess.

adjuster_notes.pending: Burst pipe in upstairs bathroom caused ceiling collapse below. Claim submitted with repair quotes.
adjuster_notes.reviewed: Internal pipe failure confirmed — no flood involvement. Ceiling and flooring in two rooms damaged. Total repair estimate GBP 9500. Policy sub-limit for internal water damage is GBP 8100. Payable amount: GBP 8100 - GBP 500 excess = GBP 7600. Partial payment applies.

adjuster_notes.pending: Storm caused large oak tree to fall on garden fence and shed. Claim submitted with photos.
adjuster_notes.reviewed: Arborist report confirms tree was healthy and showed no prior disease. Damage caused by storm wind gusts (100+ km/h recorded locally). No known-risk exclusion applies. Repair estimate reviewed and verified. Eligible less excess.

adjuster_notes.pending: Lightning strike caused surge damage to home electronics. TV, router and two computers affected. Claim submitted.
adjuster_notes.reviewed: Lightning event confirmed by meteorological data. Insured has whole-home surge protector installed, which is in spec. Sub-limit for electronics per event is GBP 2300. Four items totalling GBP 2700 claimed; payable capped at GBP 2300. After GBP 250 excess: GBP 2050. Partial payment applies.

adjuster_notes.pending: Vehicle stolen from driveway overnight. No keyfob signal detected. Police report filed. CCTV from neighbour shows masked individuals.
adjuster_notes.reviewed: Police report confirmed. Vehicle was attended (key inside house, locked). No negligent-security exclusion applies. CCTV corroborates theft. Total loss value agreed at GBP 18500. Eligible for full amount less excess.
